name: Identity Fusion NG
description: Identity Fusion NG is a connector that allows you to manage Identity Fusion accounts by mapping account attributes from multiple sources, defining new attributes and unique identifiers, and matching accounts with existing identities to prevent duplicates.

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Configure how this connector connects to Identity Security Cloud.

Use Identity Security Cloud API URL to specify the base URL of your ISC tenant (for example, https://tenant.api.identitynow.com).

Provide the Personal Access Token ID and Personal Access Token Secret for an account that has the required API permissions (Sources, Identities, Accounts, Workflows/Forms). These values are used to authenticate all connector operations.

items.label: Identity Security Cloud API URL
items.helpKey: Base URL of your Identity Security Cloud tenant (format: https:// .api.identitynow.com). See [Identity Security Cloud API URL](configuration/connection.md#baseurl).

items.label: Personal Access Token ID
items.helpKey: Enter the Client ID from your Personal Access Token. See [Personal Access Token ID](configuration/connection.md#clientid).

items.label: Personal Access Token secret
items.helpKey: Enter the Client Secret from your Personal Access Token. See [Personal Access Token secret](configuration/connection.md#clientsecret).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Define which identities are in scope.

Limit processing using an Identity Scope Query (standard ISC search syntax). Toggle Include identities in the scope to establish a baseline for Match.

items.label: Include identities in the scope?
items.helpKey: When enabled, existing identities are included alongside accounts from your configured sources. See [Include identities in the scope?](configuration/source.md#includeidentities).

items.label: Identity Scope Query
items.helpKey: Filter which identities are included using a search query. See [Identity Scope Query](configuration/source.md#identityscopequery).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Select and configure authoritative account sources.

  • Source type & behavior: Define role (Authoritative, Record, Orphan) and handling for non-matched non-identity accounts (disable, defer).
  • Aggregation & correlation: Control timing (delays, retries), optimized aggregation, and correlation strategy (in-process or reverse).
  • Filtering & limits: Process subsets via API/JMESPath filters and set batch capacities.

items.label: Source name
items.helpKey: Enter the exact name of the source as it appears in Identity Security Cloud (case-sensitive). See [Source name](configuration/source.md#name).

items.label: Enabled
items.helpKey: Turn off to temporarily exclude this source from processing without removing it. See [Enabled](configuration/source.md#enabled).

items.label: Source type
items.helpKey: Choose how accounts from this source are handled. See [Source type](configuration/source.md#sourcetype).

items.label: Disable non-matching accounts
items.helpKey: Automatically disable orphan accounts that no longer match any identity after aggregation. See [Disable non-matching accounts](configuration/source.md#disablenonmatchingaccounts).

items.label: Deferred candidate matching
items.helpKey: Deferred candidate matching: after identity scoring, also compare this account to other provisional Fusion accounts from the same source in this run. See [Deferred candidate matching](configuration/source.md#deferredmatching).

items.label: Include record accounts in Match
items.helpKey: Enable when record accounts should be matched against Fusion identities. See [Include record accounts in Match](configuration/source.md#includerecordaccountsformatching).

items.label: Accounts API filter
items.helpKey: Server-side ISC account filter sent to the Accounts API (filters parameter). See [Accounts API filter](configuration/source.md#accountfilter).

items.label: Accounts JMESPath filter
items.helpKey: Client-side JMESPath expression applied after accounts are fetched (page-wise as { accounts: [...] }). See [Accounts JMESPath filter](configuration/source.md#accountjmespathfilter).

items.label: Aggregation batch size
items.helpKey: Limit the number of accounts processed per run. See [Aggregation batch size](configuration/source.md#accountlimit).

items.label: Account aggregation mode
items.helpKey: Choose when to pull the latest accounts from this source. See [Account aggregation mode](configuration/source.md#aggregationmode).

items.label: Aggregation wait timeout (minutes)
items.helpKey: Maximum time to wait for this source's aggregation to finish when using Aggregate before processing. See [Aggregation wait timeout (minutes)](configuration/source.md#aggregationtimeout).

items.label: Aggregation delay (minutes)
items.helpKey: How many minutes to wait after processing completes before refreshing accounts from this source. See [Aggregation delay (minutes)](configuration/source.md#aggregationdelay).

items.label: Optimized aggregation
items.helpKey: Only process accounts that have changed since the last run, improving performance. See [Optimized aggregation](configuration/source.md#optimizedaggregation).

items.label: Optimized aggregation
items.helpKey: Only process accounts that have changed since the last run, improving performance. See [Optimized aggregation](configuration/source.md#optimizedaggregation).

items.label: Correlation mode
items.helpKey: Choose how uncorrelated source accounts are linked to identities. See [Correlation mode](configuration/source.md#correlationmode).

items.label: Correlation attribute display name
items.helpKey: Friendly display label for the reverse-correlation attribute shown in Identity Security Cloud. See [Correlation attribute display name](configuration/source.md#correlationdisplayname).

items.label: Correlation attribute name
items.helpKey: Internal name for the attribute used to link accounts via reverse correlation. See [Correlation attribute name](configuration/source.md#correlationattribute).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Control account maintenance.

  • History limits: Cap the number of audit history messages stored per account.
  • Delete when empty: Remove the Fusion account if all its underlying source accounts are deleted.
  • Skip missing targets: Ignore source accounts missing a mapped native identity attribute.

items.label: Maximum history messages
items.helpKey: Number of processing history entries to keep per account. See [Maximum history messages](configuration/source.md#maxhistorymessages).

items.label: Delete accounts with no managed accounts left?
items.helpKey: Automatically remove a Fusion account when all of its linked source accounts have been deleted. See [Delete accounts with no managed accounts left?](configuration/source.md#deleteempty).

items.label: Skip accounts with missing ID?
items.helpKey: Skip accounts that are missing a unique identity value. See [Skip accounts with missing ID?](configuration/source.md#skipaccountswithmissingid).

items.label: Enable cascade aggregation for single account read
items.helpKey: When enabled, triggers aggregation of managed sources before fetching managed accounts during single account operations (e.g., accountRead). See [Enable cascade aggregation for single account read](configuration/source.md#cascadeaggregationenabled).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Map and merge source attributes.

Choose a Default attribute merge mode. Then configure per-attribute rules to target specific source fields, rename them on the Fusion account, and optionally override the merge strategy or pin specific sources.

items.label: Default attribute merge from multiple sources
items.helpKey: When multiple sources provide the same attribute, choose how to combine them. See [Default attribute merge from multiple sources](configuration/mapping.md#attributemerge).

items.label: New attribute
items.helpKey: Name for this attribute on the Fusion account. See [New attribute](configuration/mapping.md#newattribute).

items.label: Existing attributes
items.helpKey: Source attribute names to pull values from. See [Existing attributes](configuration/mapping.md#existingattributes).

items.label: Default attribute merge from multiple sources
items.helpKey: Override the default merge strategy for this specific attribute. See [Default attribute merge from multiple sources](configuration/mapping.md#attributemerge).

items.label: Source name
items.helpKey: Name of the source whose value should be used for this attribute when available. See [Source name](configuration/mapping.md#source).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Define dynamic computed attributes. Apache Velocity; optional per-definition refresh. Post-template options: case, character normalization, spaces, trim, max length.

Context:
  • Mapped attributes as $name
  • $identity
  • $accounts — ordered by configured sources, then insertion order within each source; non-configured sources are appended
  • $account — the origin snapshot (managed match, or identity-origin row when the origin is Identities). $account may differ from $accounts[0] because $accounts follows the configured source order, not the origin
  • $previous

Snapshot shape:
  • Each $accounts[] entry (and the per-source list in $sources) includes the source account attributes plus:
    • source.id / source.name
    • schema.id (native identity) / schema.name (display name)
  • Rows from the Identities source use source.name = "Identities" with no source.id

Sources map:
  • $sources is a Map keyed by source name — access values with dot access, e.g. $sources.SourceName

Order:
  • Top to bottom; each result is available to the next

Helpers:
  • $Math
  • $Datefns — format, parse, parseISO, getYear, addDays/Months/Years, subDays/Months/Years, isBefore, isAfter, isEqual, differenceInDays, startOfDay, endOfDay, now, isValid
  • $Normalize — date, phone, name, fullName, ssn, address, ascii; $Normalize.address(address, country?) accepts an optional country code ("US", "GB", or "UK" alias) and normalizes a full state/region name to its ISO code (e.g. "California" → "CA", "Greater London" → "LND"); defaults to "US" and falls back to the trimmed original for unsupported country codes; $Normalize.ascii(input, language?) transliterates non-ASCII characters to ASCII with optional language-specific digraph rules ("de": ä→ae, ö→oe, ü→ue, ß→ss; "no"/"da"/"sv": ä→ae, ö→oe, å→aa, ø→oe); without a language, falls back to generic transliteration; output is lowercase
  • $AddressParse — getCityState, getCityStateCode, parse, getStateName, getStateCode; $AddressParse.getStateName(code, country) returns the full state/region name (or empty string for unknown codes); $AddressParse.getStateCode(name, country) returns the ISO code (case-insensitive; empty string for unknown names); supported countries are "US", "GB", and "UK" (alias for GB); getCityState and getCityStateCode are deprecated due to ambiguous city-only lookups
  • $JSON — stringify / parse ( parse returns undefined for null/non-string/empty/invalid input; stringify returns empty string on failure)
  • $MD5 — callable function returning a lowercase hex MD5 digest (e.g. $MD5($email)); returns empty string for null, non-string, or whitespace-only input; for deterministic identifiers, not password or secret hashing

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Define persistent unique attributes (e.g. identifiers). Values stay until account reset (e.g. disable/re-enable). Runs after normal definitions on refresh — same Velocity context plus outputs from normal definitions that run first; list order applies within unique definitions too.

Unique variables: $counter — collision mode renders the empty string on the first try and a padded suffix on subsequent attempts (padding per Minimum counter digits), retries capped by Maximum attempts; auto-appended if missing and no $UUID — but the auto-append is skipped when the expression contains Velocity directives (#if, #set, #else, #end, etc.) because appending after #end would break parsing; in that case include $counter explicitly. $UUID: a fresh v4 is generated per attempt when the expression references it. $isUnique(value): a helper injected into unique expressions that returns true when the value (after applying the same case / trim / spaces / normalize / maxLength transforms the definition would apply) is not already registered as in use — useful for choosing between candidate formats before the connector falls back to automatic $counter disambiguation.

Use incremental counter?: when on, the counter is persistent (survives across aggregations) and always increments; the first number comes from Counter start value (default 1). When off (default), the connector uses collision-based disambiguation described above.

Sub-modes of Unique: include $UUID in the expression for UUID generation (the expression is required); toggle Use incremental counter? for sequential IDs.

Helpers: $Normalize (date, phone, name, fullName, ssn, address, ascii) — $Normalize.date(date, ambiguousPriority?) accepts an optional priority string like "MM-dd-yyyy,dd-MM-yyyy" for ambiguous dates; $Normalize.phone(phone, defaultCountry?) accepts an optional default country code (e.g. "GB") used when the input lacks an international prefix; $Normalize.ascii(input, language?) transliterates non-ASCII characters to ASCII with optional language-specific digraph rules ("de": ä→ae, ö→oe, ü→ue, ß→ss; "no"/"da"/"sv": ä→ae, ö→oe, å→aa, ø→oe); without a language, falls back to generic transliteration; output is lowercase. $AddressParse (getCityState, getCityStateCode, parse, getStateName, getStateCode). getStateName(code, country) returns the full state/region name (or empty string for unknown codes); getStateCode(name, country) returns the ISO code (case-insensitive; empty string for unknown names). Supported countries are "US", "GB", and "UK" (alias for GB). getCityState and getCityStateCode are deprecated due to ambiguous city-only lookups. Bad inputs render empty. $Math / $Datefns / $JSON (stringify, parse) / $MD5 — see Normal Attribute Definitions.

Reuse: existing values are reused unless this run refreshes the account, the account resets, or a unique value is empty (retry).

items.label: Maximum attempts for unique definition
items.helpKey: Maximum number of tries to find a value that is not already taken. See [Maximum attempts for unique definition](configuration/definition.md#maxattempts).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Configure similarity-based match detection.

Evaluate matches using Fusion attribute matches to calculate a Combined match score.
  • Algorithms: Text, phonetic, and intelligent gap comparisons.
  • Thresholds & weights: Set minimum scores for individual rules and the overall match. Pass thresholds double as blend weights.
  • Automatic merge: Optionally bypass manual review and automatically merge the managed account into the matched Fusion identity if the combined score meets or exceeds your defined automatic merge threshold.

items.label: Manual review match score [0-100]
items.helpKey: Minimum weighted combined similarity (0-100) required for a potential match. See [Manual review match score [0-100]](configuration/matching.md#fusionmanualreviewscore).

items.label: Enable automatic merge
items.helpKey: When enabled, merge the managed account into the matched Fusion identity without a review form if the combined score meets or exceeds the automatic merge match score. See [Enable automatic merge](configuration/matching.md#fusionenableautomerge).

items.label: Automatic merge match score [0-100]
items.helpKey: Matches with a combined score equal to or higher than this threshold will be automatically merged. See [Automatic merge match score [0-100]](configuration/matching.md#fusionautomergescore).

items.label: Attribute
items.helpKey: The identity attribute to compare when looking for matches (e.g. See [Attribute](configuration/matching.md#attribute).

items.label: Matching algorithm
items.helpKey: Algorithm used to compare values. See [Matching algorithm](configuration/matching.md#algorithm).

options.label: Enhanced Name Matcher
options.docLinkLabel: Strict matching that handles accents and normalization

options.label: Jaro-Winkler
options.docLinkLabel: Mechanical string comparison tolerant of typos

options.label: LIG3
options.docLinkLabel: Advanced hybrid handling missing gaps and character variations

options.label: Dice
options.docLinkLabel: N-gram model highly tolerant of word reordering

options.label: Double Metaphone
options.docLinkLabel: Evaluates strings based on their English pronunciation

items.label: Custom match score (Velocity)
items.helpKey: Apache Velocity template evaluated for each account/identity pair. See [Custom match score (Velocity)](configuration/matching.md#customvelocityexpression).

items.label: Similarity threshold & weight [0-100]
items.helpKey: One setting, two roles: (1) minimum similarity (0-100) the rule must meet to pass, and (2) blend weight in the combined score—higher means stricter and more influence. See [Similarity threshold & weight [0-100]](configuration/matching.md#fusionscore).

items.label: Mandatory match
items.helpKey: When enabled, this rule must meet its minimum similarity for a potential match. See [Mandatory match](configuration/matching.md#mandatory).

items.label: Skip match if missing
items.helpKey: When enabled (default), this rule is skipped if either value is missing (null, undefined, or empty after trimming). See [Skip match if missing](configuration/matching.md#skipmatchifmissing).

items.label: Skip match if threshold not met
items.helpKey: When enabled, this rule is excluded from the weighted combined match score if its computed similarity is below its minimum similarity (Similarity threshold & weight). See [Skip match if threshold not met](configuration/matching.md#skipmatchifthresholdnotmet).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Configure manual review for potential matches.

Define Form attributes to display to reviewers and set candidate limits. Assign global reviewers to act as fail-safes and optionally email them processing reports after each aggregation.

items.label: List of Fusion account attributes to include in form
items.helpKey: Account attributes displayed on the review form to help reviewers compare potential matches. See [List of Fusion account attributes to include in form](configuration/matching.md#fusionformattributes).

items.label: Maximum candidates per review form
items.helpKey: Maximum number of potential identity matches shown on each manual review form. See [Maximum candidates per review form](configuration/matching.md#fusionmaxcandidatesforform).

items.label: Manual review expiration days
items.helpKey: Number of days a reviewer has to respond before the review form expires. See [Manual review expiration days](configuration/matching.md#fusionformexpirationdays).

items.label: Owners are global reviewers?
items.helpKey: Always add the source owner and any member of the source's assigned governance group as reviewers on every review form, ensuring someone is always assigned to review potential matc. See [Owners are global reviewers?](configuration/matching.md#fusionownerisglobalreviewer).

items.label: Send report to owner on aggregation?
items.helpKey: Send a summary report to the source owner after each run, including potential matches, processing outcomes, and source-type breakdown metrics. See [Send report to owner on aggregation?](configuration/matching.md#fusionreportonaggregation).

items.label: Enable localized user communications?
items.helpKey: Translate emails, reports, and Fusion reviews to the recipient's preferred language. See [Enable localized user communications?](configuration/matching.md#enablelocalization).

items.label: Default Language
items.helpKey: The default language to use when the recipient's language cannot be determined. See [Default Language](configuration/matching.md#defaultlanguage).

items.label: Identity Language Attribute
items.helpKey: Identity attribute containing the user's preferred language. See [Identity Language Attribute](configuration/matching.md#identitylanguageattribute).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Advanced options for troubleshooting and performance tuning.

Use these settings to safely recover from configuration changes (e.g. rebuilding accounts or forcing attribute recalculation), manage memory consumption during match detection by adjusting batch sizes, and configure external logging for centralized monitoring.

v2.2.0

items.label: Reset accounts?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, clear all Fusion account data and emit zero accounts (rebuild from scratch on the following run). See [Reset accounts?](configuration/advanced.md#resetaccounts).

items.label: Reset forms?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, delete all Fusion review form definitions. See [Reset forms?](configuration/advanced.md#resetforms).

items.label: Force attribute refresh on next aggregation?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, recalculate all computed Normal-type attributes even if no changes were detected. See [Force attribute refresh on next aggregation?](configuration/advanced.md#forceattributerefresh).

items.label: Enable concurrency check?
items.helpKey: Safeguard against data conflicts if multiple aggregations overlap. See [Enable concurrency check?](configuration/advanced.md#concurrencycheckenabled).

items.label: Enable external logging?
items.helpKey: Stream connector execution logs directly to external monitoring services like Splunk or Datadog for centralized troubleshooting. See [Enable external logging?](configuration/advanced.md#externalloggingenabled).

items.label: External logging URL
items.helpKey: The URL where logs should be sent (e.g. See [External logging URL](configuration/advanced.md#externalloggingurl).

items.label: External logging level
items.helpKey: Choose the detail level for external logs. See [External logging level](configuration/advanced.md#externallogginglevel).

items.label: Managed accounts batch size
items.helpKey: Number of uncorrelated managed accounts processed in each match detection batch. See [Managed accounts batch size](configuration/advanced.md#managedaccountsbatchsize).

items.label: Scoring concurrency limit
items.helpKey: Maximum concurrent identity-comparison scoring operations during managed-account analysis. See [Scoring concurrency limit](configuration/advanced.md#scoringmaxconcurrency).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Fine-tune API limits and execution resilience.

Adjust these parameters to prevent the connector from being rate-limited by Identity Security Cloud, ensure long-running operations complete without timing out, and optimize the throughput by adjusting request concurrency and batching sizes.

items.label: Provisioning timeout (seconds)
items.helpKey: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a provisioning operation to complete. See [Provisioning timeout (seconds)](configuration/advanced.md#provisioningtimeout).

items.label: Maximum concurrent requests
items.helpKey: How many HTTP requests can run at the same time. See [Maximum concurrent requests](configuration/advanced.md#maxconcurrentrequests).

items.label: Parallel pagination batch size
items.helpKey: Max in-flight parallel pages per pagination stream. See [Parallel pagination batch size](configuration/advanced.md#parallelbatchsize).

items.label: Requests per second
items.helpKey: Legacy rate hint: derives the sliding-window cap as requests per second × 10 seconds (max 100). See [Requests per second](configuration/advanced.md#requestspersecond).

items.label: API request retries
items.helpKey: How many times to retry a failed request before giving up. See [API request retries](configuration/advanced.md#maxretries).

items.label: Processing wait time (seconds)
items.helpKey: How often (in seconds) to send a progress signal during long operations to prevent timeouts. See [Processing wait time (seconds)](configuration/advanced.md#processingwait).

items.label: Heartbeat interval (seconds)
items.helpKey: How often (in seconds) the connector emits STATUS and EVENT_SUMMARY lines during long operations. See [Heartbeat interval (seconds)](configuration/advanced.md#heartbeatinterval).

items.label: Enable priority processing?
items.helpKey: Process critical operations (like saving data) before less urgent ones (like logging). See [Enable priority processing?](configuration/advanced.md#enablepriority).

items.sectionHelpMessage:
Delegate processing to your own infrastructure.

Configure the connector to route all processing through a self-hosted proxy server, which allows you to execute operations outside of the cloud environment while maintaining secure authentication.

items.label: Enable proxy mode?
items.helpKey: Offload processing workload to your own infrastructure by routing operations through a dedicated server, which is useful for highly restricted or specialized environments. See [Enable proxy mode?](configuration/advanced.md#proxyenabled).

items.label: Proxy URL
items.helpKey: The URL of your proxy server that will handle connector operations. See [Proxy URL](configuration/advanced.md#proxyurl).

items.label: Proxy password
items.helpKey: A shared secret used to authenticate with your proxy server. See [Proxy password](configuration/advanced.md#proxypassword).
